evidence: Pairwise read of all 50 criteria (3 gate, 38 functional weight 54.0, 6 polish, 3 visual). No pair demands incompatible products (Tab-indent vs keyboard exit is reconciled by 'whatever key sequence the app states', polish/judge.toml:23; 5 s brief vs 10 s criteria is only lenient). Most apparent overlaps are legitimate prerequisites/positive controls or distinct triggers of one public rule (stale-save refused vs keeps-draft, functional/judge.toml:317,326; last-good restore after throw/time-limit/stop; live-update control at :353) and are not counted. Three real same-observable duplicates remain. (1) Multi-caret burst = one Undo is graded in cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic (functional/judge.toml:101 'One Undo must remove all fifteen inserted characters ... Fails if ... the burst needs more than one Undo') and again in cw_same_line_carets (functional/judge.toml:119 'a further Undo must remove the typed characters ... Fails if ... the line after either Undo is not exact'), both weight 2.0; the public rule is one sentence, ui.md:9. (2) Redo cleared by a new edit after Undo is graded in functional cw_replace_all_atomic (functional/judge.toml:155 'type one new character: Redo must then be unavailable ... Fails ... if Redo still works after the new edit') and again in polish cw_undo_redo_availability (polish/judge.toml:51 'Type another character: Redo becomes unavailable again'); public rule ui.md:11 plus ui.md:9 last sentence. (3) Presence of the failure reason is re-graded: cw_output_before_failure_kept (functional/judge.toml:245) requires each marker 'together with, and above, the visible reason for that run (the error, the time limit, or the stop)', while the error reason is graded at :227, the time-limit reason at :263 and the stop reason at :272; its third draft is also the identical 3 s timer / Stop-at-1 s scenario of :272. Its fail clause omits a missing reason, so the conjunction rule in functional/prompt.md:12 makes the outcome judge-dependent. Minor of the same kind: cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft (:362 'A must still show that its draft is unsaved') re-grades the indicator owned by polish cw_unsaved_marker (polish/judge.toml:60). Not exercised by any configured judge run; finding is from source reading.
counterexample: Weak-app direction: an app with fully correct multi-caret placement, same-line offset tracking, typing and Backspace, whose only defect is that a multi-caret typing burst is undone one keystroke per Undo. It deserves to lose cw_multi_caret_typing_atomic (2.0) but also loses cw_same_line_carets (2.0), i.e. 4.0/54 = 7.4% of functional for one defect, although every same-line-specific behaviour is correct. Second: an app that does not clear Redo after a new edit loses functional cw_replace_all_atomic (1.5/54) and polish cw_undo_redo_availability (1/6 of polish) for the same single observation; the polish fail clause ('looks available when it has nothing to do') would actually pass it because Redo still has something to do, so the step list and fail clause disagree. Third: an app whose Stop works and cancels but shows no stop reason fails :272 and, depending on how the judge reads the conjunction, :245 as well.
suggested_fix: Keep each observable in one criterion. In cw_same_line_carets replace 'a further Undo must remove the typed characters' with 'further Undo presses, however many the app needs, must return the exact original line' and drop burst atomicity from its fail clause. In polish cw_undo_redo_availability drop the fourth point (Redo unavailable after a new edit) or reword it so only the control's disabled appearance when Redo is functionally empty is judged. In cw_output_before_failure_kept say the marker must remain visible after the run has ended and, where a reason is shown, sit above it, with 'whether a reason is shown is scored separately'; and use a fixture that differs from the cw_stop_cancels_pending_work run or state that the same run may be shared. In cw_newer_revision_notice_keeps_draft replace 'must still show that its draft is unsaved' with the draft-text and not-loaded observations already listed.
